model_output.rationale: All four lines carry CO-29 (timely filing expired). DOS is 20250224. The 277CA — same BHT control number TRC65023992 — shows clearinghouse acceptance (A2:20) dated 20250302, six days after DOS. That is well within any commercial filing window. The July 2025 837P ISA date reflects a later artifact generation; the March acceptance report is the operative filing proof. Appeal citing the 277CA to dispute the payer's receipt-date determination.

root_cause.explanation: All four lines denied CO-29. DOS 20250224; payer remit dated 20250812. 277CA shows clearinghouse acceptance (A2:20) for the same transaction TRC65023992 on 20250302 — 6 days post-DOS, timely under any commercial filing limit.

next_action.detail: File a redetermination/appeal with Keystone disputing the receipt date. Attach the 277CA (STC*A2:20, dated 20250302) as proof of timely clearinghouse acceptance. N211 on a commercial remit has no binding force (ref 03-timely-filing.md: N211 applied in error).

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*29 on all four service lines; MOA N211; $0 paid
DOS 20250224 for all lines; BHT control TRC65023992
STC*A2:20 (accepted) dated 20250302 for TRC65023992 — same transaction, 6 days post-DOS
Proof of clearinghouse acceptance inside the window → appeal disputing receipt date; N211 has been applied in error on commercial remits

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report
N211 has also been applied in error (R3118CP)
CO-29 with no exception → do_not_resubmit; but exception (proof of timely filing) → appeal
